name: agy-genui
description: Generative UI for Antigravity — render interactive UI components (charts, tables, diffs, forms, quizzes, timelines) inline from declarative JSON via <agent-embed>. Charts support line/area/bar/grouped/stacked/pie/donut/scatter with hover tooltips, legend toggle and crosshair. Zero dependencies, CSP-safe.
suggestedPrompts: Build a sortable session-stats table with agy-genui
Chart my token usage over the last 7 days
Create an interactive quiz to test my Antigravity knowledge
